description: This file defines the ProductPrice class, which encapsulates details about product pricing, including descriptions, availability, and special pricing dates within the product management system.

classes.name: ProductPrice
classes.description: Represents the pricing details for a product, including descriptions, availability, and special pricing periods.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of product price descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of product price descriptions.

methods.name: getPriceText
methods.description: Returns the textual representation of the price.

methods.name: setPriceText
methods.description: Sets the textual representation of the price.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the product associated with this price.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a product with this price.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the special price period as a string.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialStartDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the special price period.

methods.name: getProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the special price period as a string.

methods.name: setProductPriceSpecialEndDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the special price period.
